title: SSC CHSL Chemistry
summary: SSC CHSL Tier I Chemistry past questions from 6 shifts, 2024 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 24 SSC CHSL Tier I shifts, July 2024 and November 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC rarely asks a General Awareness question again in these shifts; a fact list it keeps drawing on is a type. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC_GK.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
